description: Scanned redacted remittance advice. Recover legible text; the source line items require a table, not invented numeric prose: at least five rows of twelve columns (a header, three line items and the claim totals, not counting the member and provider band ruled under the header, which a faithful table may keep as a sixth row). The totals row is found by its billed total, 268.00 in column 3, because the unruled Claim Totals label spans columns 0 to 2.

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: This page has no text layer; it requires OCR.
contains: PAYMENT REDUCED BY MEDICARE OR OTHER INSURANCE PAYMENT

assertions.xfail: OCR does not reconstruct the ruled line-item table and corrupts its numeric values.
The scan layout promotes many fragments of addresses and column labels to headings.
#291: OCR's misreadings of the small print are kept.
#291: OCR misreads the small print, and its low-confidence words get no second reading.
